name: flow-by-intellignce
description: Flow by Intellignce - AI-native Business Operating System foundation.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flow/commercial build && pnpm --filter @flow/database build && pnpm -r --if-present build
scripts.blm:knowledge:taxonomy:generate: pnpm --filter @flow/blm-contracts build && pnpm --filter @flow/blm-core build && node scripts/blm-taxonomy-artifacts.mjs && prettier --write knowledge/blm/compiled/taxonomy/global-business-taxonomy-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/architecture/reference-business-architecture-graph-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/capabilities/universal-capability-registry-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/expertise/blm-expertise-packs-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/expertise/role-expertise-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/evaluations/business-taxonomy-demonstrations-v1.json
scripts.blm:knowledge:runtime:generate: pnpm --filter @flow/blm-contracts build && pnpm --filter @flow/blm-core build && node scripts/blm-runtime-knowledge-artifacts.mjs && prettier --write knowledge/blm/compiled/modules/business-module-registry-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/modules/digital-agency-module-recommendations-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/building-blocks/building-block-registry-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/building-blocks/digital-agency-building-block-plan-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/reasoning/compiled-blm-context-demo-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/reasoning/blm-knowledge-release-manifest-v1.json knowledge/blm/compiled/evaluations/blm-runtime-evaluation-v1.json
scripts.quality:gate: pnpm oss:governance:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm quality:hooks:test && pnpm quality:secret-scan
